overall: Clean final draft: checker ok_rate 1.0, all 75 pool tokens covered (71 multi, 4 exclusive), and the exclusive calls (COVID, COVID-no-space, avax, demic) hold up under the real prompt tokenization (academic/endemic/epidemic/Javax/javax do not produce demic or avax in normal text). Facts are accurate and the writer consistently steered core-concept tokens (coronavirus, CoV, SARS, pandemic, lockdown, mask, vaccine, Wuhan, Trump, Jinping, sonaro) to pre-2020 or unrelated uses. Only two items are dropped, both because pandemic coverage made the tested fact famous: ivermectin being an antiparasitic rather than an antiviral, and ritonavir boosting other drugs (Paxlovid). Borderline but kept: 2003 SARS facts, the pandemic-vs-epidemic definition, coronaviruses causing colds, and some moderately obscure trivia (MERS in South Korea 2015, Pandemic Studios/EA, Patrick Sarsfield). These are general or pre-COVID knowledge and are not clear violations. A few multi tokens have fewer than 4 items (coronav 2, Omicron 2, onavir 2 then 1, infec 1, several with 3), each justified in the notes.
